scope: One authored clean synthetic WAV; no physical recording or simulated channel test
phrase: Wasn't Orin curious about this map? [2]

meaning.criterion: The experiencer has epistemic interest in the contextual inquiry: resolving some contextually relevant uncertainty about the topic is itself motivationally attractive, rather than wanted solely for a separate practical outcome. Instrumental motives may coexist. This does not require pleasure, current attention, a conscious feeling, intention, action, successful discovery or complete ignorance of the topic.
limitations: Context must identify the topic and relevant questions.
This draft epistemic reading is not oddness, sensory novelty seeking or purely instrumental information demand.
